key_points: After-hours uptick linked to Apollo's reported $20B discussion to acquire J&J's orthopedics business – potential cash infusion.
No concrete deal confirmed; market reaction likely limited to short-term speculation.
Other headlines are analyst commentary (Stelara biosimilar risk, recent performance) with minimal immediate price effect.
J&J's pipeline and recent drug launches remain positive but already priced in.
Overall thesis unchanged; modest bullish bias from possible divestiture.
